body: 24 Nov 2026, a heads-up for whoever rebases the DRAFT PR #1 (P2-14, lyrics on the server): it still carries a migration numbered 0009, but main now has migrations up to 0018 (P2-25 slice 4) and N-34 slice 2 (PR 125) takes 0019. On the rebase take the NEXT FREE number after whatever main holds then: look at server/encore_server/encore_server/migrations yourself, never at this note (migrate refuses duplicate numbers and the numbers are decided by merge order). The PR stays on hold until b11.
